final_answer: Both BRCA1 and TP53 map to human chromosome 17 (taxid 9606); they are not distributed across different chromosomes. Using the EBI Proteins API coordinates endpoint (…/proteins/api/coordinates?gene=<GENE>&taxid=9606), returned as JSON: TP53 is on chromosome 17, GRCh38, reverse strand, start 7,675,134 / end 7,673,222 (nucleotide CM000679.2; Ensembl gene ENSG00000141510, transcript ENST00000610623), with exon genomic locations such as 7,675,134–7,675,053 (ENSE00002064269). BRCA1 coordinates also fall on chromosome 17 in the GRCh38 region around 43,124,096–43,091,435 (exon examples 43,124,096–43,124,017 and 43,091,435 downstream), confirming BRCA1 and TP53 are both chr17 genes. This information can be accessed in JSON by adding format=json to the search_genomic_coordinates call (reviewed human, taxid 9606) and validated against GRCh38/Ensembl coordinates in genomic databases.
